title: Missed publishing
note: Payments omitted from the originally published reports. Includes Felinesoft Ltd, both added payments labelled CLOSED Clearcourse Membership Services Ltd (Felinesoft) and published payments renamed to that name, AECOM payments that were added or removed, payments to North Somerset Council, payments to Avon Pension Fund, and payments to Bath & North East Somerset Council General Suspense Account, including the published payment renamed to Bristol City Council. There are no changed AECOM payments in the diff. North Somerset Enterprise Agency is not included. Also Carlisle Staffing Plc T/A Guidant Global, Building Research Establishment, Placecube, Pixie Energy, Opinion Research Services, Comensura, and Constellia, including added rows and rows renamed to or from those names. Also Data Cubed Ltd, Gloucestershire County Council, Graham Tate T/A Exceptional Development, Grant Thornton, Grant Thornton UK LLP, HMRC, ICO, South Gloucestershire Council, Spark South West, University of Bath, University of the West of England, and WSP UK Limited.
